records.quote: Theorem 3.8. Suppose X1, ..., Xn and X1*, ..., Xn* are independent samples with Xi ~ ENH(α1, λ1, βi), and Xi* ~ ENH(α2, λ2, βi*), i = 1, ..., n. Then for α1 ≤ α2 and λ > 0, we have Σi=1^n βi = Σi=1^n βi* ⟹ Xn:n ≥c Xn:n*.
records.family: ENH(α, λ, β) — exponentiated new-generation class
records.compared: Xn:n vs Xn:n* in the convex transform order; equal β sums, outer shapes α1 ≤ α2
records.ambiguity: A's 'star' label is wrong — ≥c is the convex transform order (Def 2.1(i): G⁻¹F convex), not the star order. Printed condition 'α1 ≤ α2 and λ > 0' presumably means λ1, λ2 > 0; the proof's h(x) = ((1+λ2x)^{α2/α1} − 1)/λ1 needs only α2 ≥ α1 for convexity. Statement on p.8, proof continues to p.9.

note: Adjudicated to B's label 'other: convex transform order (≥c)' — A's 'star' misclassifies the order. Verified verbatim on p.8–9.
